market_view: Pre-market 6:40 ET Friday, risk-off: yesterday the S&P 500 fell 2.0% (Dow -1,100) after Anthropic's debut didn't rescue the AI trade, and Fed officials sounded hawkish. Now Nasdaq 100 futures are about -1.5%: AMD 458.85 (-6.2%) on a Hunterbrook short report about its China exposure, TSM -4.1%, NVDA 142.58 (-2.3%), CRWV -4.4%, KLAC -2.8%. SPY 711.59, QQQ 635.86, IWM 263.95, VIX 29.7, 10-year 5.05%, WTI US$82.40, gold US$3,591, BTC US$61,743 with Fear & Greed 12. The desk trades small and keeps cash.

events.name: Thu Nov 19: Anthropic (ANT) debut and a reversal
events.actual: ANT priced at US$83 and closed about 17% higher on day one, but the S&P 500 fell 2.0% (SPY 715.87), QQQ 645.04, GOOGL -3.5%, VIX near 30

events.name: Overnight: Hunterbrook short report on AMD; hawkish Fed remarks
events.actual: Short seller says AMD's China exposure is higher than disclosed

events.name: Sat Nov 21: Paper Desk weekly review

scenarios.then: Rout-day filter: Dax waits until 10:30 and takes three trades max; no new swing or long buys
The flush is bought: Dax runs his list; Vega's QQQ call plan stays off unless above 650
Sam's NVDA stop (about US$145) is already hit; no re-buy today
Nobody buys AMD into a short report; it's on the avoid list
Kai stays in crash mode; stops handle exits

avoid.AMD: short-seller report (Hunterbrook) on its China exposure: no new buys today
avoid.ANT: two-day-old IPO, no price history for stops

shared_notes: Risk-off Friday (VIX near 30): three day trades max, no new swing or long buys, no AMD or ANT.
Option orders go live at 9:45 ET; Vega and Theo meet at 9:31 first.

day.view: Dax: Yesterday was choppy: NCPL paid half at 1R and then stopped at breakeven; MAGN and YMAT went flat at the close, small losses. Today VIX is near 30 and Nasdaq futures are -1.5%, which is my rout-day lesson exactly: clean breaks are rare. I wait until 10:30, take three trades max, and stop at -4%.

playbook.then: one squeeze setup at most, and only with 5x volume
up to three trades on the squeeze list

playbook.if: price runs past entry plus half an R

plan_c.note: Down 4% on the day: stand aside

day.failsafe: Down 4% on the day or VIX over 32: stand aside.
lessons_applied: Rout-day filter: gap-down with VIX 25+, so nothing before 10:30.
Squeeze ORB only; plain ORB+VWAP setups skipped.

swing.view: Sam: Rough day yesterday: ABNB, TRMK and CVBF all hit their stops, about -C$104 in total. I bought one NVDA share at C$212.66 (US$148.70) on the dip, and at US$142.58 pre-market its stop (about US$145) will trigger at the open. That's the rule working. I now hold CRWV, COIN and RKT with C$1,351 cash, and I buy nothing new until VIX calms.

playbook.then: let it sell; no re-buy today
the scan list gets a fresh look

plan_b.note: NVDA stopped: no replacement today, cash waits

plan_c.note: Fear is up: no new buys

swing.failsafe: VIX over 26 or a 5% day loss: no new buys, stops stay.
lessons_applied: Three stops in one day: no same-day replacement buys.
When the tape turns, cash is a position.

long.view: Lena: KLAC is US$137.58 pre-market, under my two buys but far above both stops (US$121 and the older one). This week's buy is done. A VIX near 30 is the kind of day my 18% stops are built for: I don't tighten them on one day's news.

plan_b.note: No buy today: this week's buy (KLAC) is done

plan_c.note: Fear spike: no buys this week

long.failsafe: VIX over 28: no buys this week.
lessons_applied: Weekly buy already made (KLAC); no second buy this week.
Stops stay about 18% under the buys.

futures.view: Fox: Both shorts are working. Gold is US$3,591, down from US$3,729, and my micro gold short's stop has moved down to C$5,380. Crude is US$82.40, near its US$80.78 low. Two positions open, so no new trade; stops and targets do the work.

plan_b.note: Gold short stopped: no revenge trade

plan_c.note: Down 4%: no new futures; stops stay

futures.failsafe: Down 4% on the day: no new futures; stops stay.
lessons_applied: After a big win, risk small: no second crude position.
Breaks need a 5-minute close, not a touch.

options_aggr.view: Vega: QQQ never reached 678 yesterday; the gap faded and the plan stood aside, which was right. Today is a VIX-30 flush. I'm not buying puts into a 2% down day after the move. One idea: if QQQ reclaims 650 after 9:45, 2 calls about 3% out for a bounce. Otherwise nothing.

playbook.then: no option; puts are too expensive with VIX 30

plan_b.note: QQQ reclaims 650: a bounce trade, the one trade today

orders.why: QQQ back above 650 after a VIX-30 flush: 2 calls about 3% out; -50% stop, +100% target

plan_c.note: No reclaim by 2:00: no option today

options_aggr.failsafe: Down 12% on the day or VIX over 30: no new options.
lessons_applied: Didn't chase yesterday's gap; same discipline today: only a reclaim gets the trade.
Two contracts so a risk-off cut doesn't round to zero.

options_safe.view: Theo: RKT US$13.31, still above my 12.50 strike with 21 days left. With VIX near 30, put premiums are fat, but my rule is one put at a time and RKT's uses my buying power. No new put.

playbook.then: hold, assignment at a price I chose is acceptable
the put decays faster, keep holding

playbook.if: No put across an earnings date, nothing under its 200-day

plan_b.note: No second put: the cash stays parked

options_safe.failsafe: VIX over 27: keep the cash, no new puts.
lessons_applied: One put at a time: RKT uses most of the buying power, so no new put.

crypto.view: Kai: BTC US$61,743 and Fear & Greed 12, near its 20-day low (US$61,326). Crash mode under US$65,000: no buys. The 7-day fear-add gap allows one again after the 22nd, and I'll take it only if the rules say so.

playbook.if: BTC reclaims US$68,000 and holds a day
playbook.then: still no buy, a bounce isn't a signal

playbook.if: Fear & Greed rises above 25 with BTC over US$65,000

plan_b.note: A bounce is not a buy signal: hold and keep the cash

plan_c.note: Deeper flush: still no buys; stops handle exits

crypto.failsafe: Down 8% on the day: no buys; stops stay.
lessons_applied: One extreme-fear add every 7 days: no add today.

options_convene.vega: QQQ opened at 638.81 and is already 635.87, well under my 650 reclaim level. No bounce yet, so the plan stays: 2 calls only above 650, nothing after 2:00. With VIX near 30 I won't buy expensive puts after the flush.
options_convene.theo: RKT is 13.45, above my 12.50 strike, with 21 days left. There's no live bid/ask on the put yet (last 0.35). One put at a time: no new put, cash parked.
changes: None: no option orders were planned; Vega's QQQ 650 reclaim trigger and Theo's stand-aside plans are kept
